reviews.title: Best and most useful app
reviews.contents: Finally an app that actually has helpful information that is up to date and is easy to follow. My son is 11 months. He is finally sleeping through the night and eating so much better. My hair was starting to fall out just from stress and I feel better than I have my entire time of being a mother. So much has changed from using this app it’s insane

reviews.title: Great app!
reviews.contents: This app has been soooo helpful as a first time mom. I especially love the wake window activities as that is something I have always struggled with. It gave me so much piece of mind to have all my information in one app that was easy to use and navigate. It is filled with so much helpful information and I also love how it predicts my baby’s sleep windows based on his sleep patterns. Such a cool app!
